This linter tries to ensure some measure of separation between various folders in Mathlib, by checking results in one folder (Mathlib.Computability here) do not transitively import others (Mathlib.FieldTheory here). In your PR, you added public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.PiL2 in Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.Prod, which is transitively imported by Mathlib.Computability.AkraBazzi.AkraBazzi.

This suggests you probably should add your results to a different (new?) file instead, although I am not familiar with this corner of Mathlib and couldn't say exactly where to put them.

Writing #find_home mylemma (after mylemma) suggests a file where this can be moved. Sometimes, you need to do #find_home! instead, and it does not always work --- but often, this gives you some idea.
